title: Chapter 7: Compound Restriction
paragraphs: However, the Five Elements Art wasn't a panacea.

For cultivators like Chen Mobai, whose Spiritual Root attributes were relatively balanced, the Five Elements Art was a supreme esoteric technique. The Spiritual Power cultivated through it not only harmonized perfectly with their physical constitution but also progressed at a steady pace.
Yet for those with High-Grade Spiritual Root attributes, the art was quite mediocre.

Consider Heavenly Spiritual Root cultivators, for instance. By focusing on cultivating Spiritual Power of a single attribute, they achieved twice the result with half the effort, cultivated purer Magic Power, and encountered fewer bottlenecks when breaking through cultivation realms.
Generally, every cultivator is born with 100 Spiritual Root attribute points.

Within the territories of the Immortal Sect's Grotto-Heavens and Blessed Lands, all aspiring cultivators must undergo a precise Spiritual Root assessment at a Top-Tier Hospital before entering Qi Refinement. Only those with a formal evaluation report from the hospital are admitted to the sect.
For example, Chen Mobai's attributes were: Metal 23, Wood 27, Water 23, Fire 17, Earth 10.

Immortal Sect regulations stipulate that any Spiritual Root attribute exceeding 20 indicates the presence of that element's Spiritual Root. Chen Mobai thus possessed three Spiritual Roots—Metal, Wood, and Water—barely qualifying him for the "True Spiritual Root" category.
This was precisely what infuriated his deskmate, Lu Hongsheng. His Spiritual Root attributes were: Metal 8, Wood 25, Water 23, Fire 22, Earth 22.

In essence, his attributes were nearly identical to Chen Mobai's. However, because his Spiritual Root attributes were slightly more evenly distributed, the hospital classified him as having a four-attribute Pseudo Spiritual Root.
To provide you with the latest and fastest novel updates.
As for the so-called Heavenly Spiritual Root, it referred to a Spiritual Root with over 80 points in one of the Five Elements!
This meant that even cultivators with a Heavenly Spiritual Root would still possess traces of the other four elements within their bodies, though in extremely trace amounts.
As for a theoretically perfect Heavenly Spiritual Root with 100 points in a single attribute, no such record existed in the ten thousand years of the Immortal Sect's history.

The Spiritual Power cultivated through the Five Elements Art naturally adapts to match each cultivator's Spiritual Root attributes. Even for those with Heavenly Spiritual Roots, the refined Spiritual Power would still contain traces of the other four elements, akin to unnecessary impurities.
The same principle applied to cultivators with Variant Spiritual Roots.
However, none of this mattered to Chen Mobai.

He circulated the Five Elements Art taught by the school, channeling his five elemental Spiritual Power into the glass bead. The bead began to glow with a vibrant rainbow light, resembling a solar halo rising from his palm.

These glass beads were small toys designed to train one's control over Spiritual Power. A practitioner at the First-Stage Qi Refinement could control one bead, while Chen Mobai, now at the Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement, should theoretically be able to simultaneously manipulate five beads, levitating them and directing them at will.
However, having just advanced to the Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement, his foundation was still unstable, so he decided not to push his limits.
Following Old Man Ding's instructions, he guided four glass beads toward the right side hall.
A ripple of water materialized, deflecting the first bead that arrived. A second ripple split off to repel the next bead, and a third ripple intercepted the remaining beads...
Holding his phone, Chen Mobai frowned as he studied the three spell descriptions Old Man Ding had provided.

He realized the water-wave restriction protecting the side hall combined elements of the Flowing Water Shield, Surging Wave Spell, and Scale Wave Technique. Given his current cultivation stage, breaking such a complex restriction would require either a powerful talisman or waiting until he reached Late-Stage Qi Refinement before attempting again.
"Never mind. I'll focus on cultivation for now. After all, there's plenty of time to explore the Water Abode later."
Checking the time, Chen Mobai decided not to waste the Second-Tier Mid-Grade Spiritual Land. He sat cross-legged in the center of the Front Hall and entered a meditative state, channeling his Qi.
Today, Chen Mobai sent his parents a message ahead of time, telling them he would be secluding himself in his room and not to disturb him.

Pure water-attribute spiritual energy coalesced into shimmering blue particles, refined by the Five Elements Art. Through the cyclical generation of the five elements, it transformed into spiritual power perfectly suited to Chen Mobai's spiritual root and physique. This power flowed gently through his body, nourishing the meridians and acupoints forcibly opened by the medicinal pills.

Though resources were scarce within the Immortal Sect, millennia of cultivation, coupled with resources plundered from conquest wars, had ensured a comprehensive array of spiritual medicines. Moreover, by tailoring cultivation methods to the Earth Vein Climate of each Grotto-Heaven and Blessed Land, the sect had achieved remarkable success in cultivating these medicinal herbs.

Alchemy, one of the four major disciplines of the Immortal Sect, integrated seamlessly with medical science to maximize the potential of medicinal materials. This synergistic approach formed the cornerstone of the sect's ability to sustain three hundred million cultivators with just one Star of Mortal Essence.
The Immortal Sect possessed medicinal pills corresponding to virtually every element.
However, one type of pill was rarely produced: the Foundation Establishment Pill.

Although the sect still preserved the ancient formula for this pill, its production had been banned five thousand years ago—not due to any flaw in the medicine itself, but because it was considered an extravagant waste of resources.

The Foundation Establishment Pill was a low-grade third-tier spiritual medicine, while its primary ingredient, the Jade Marrow Golden Ganoderma, was a high-grade third-tier spiritual herb. Using such a precious herb to make a Foundation Establishment Pill was a tremendous waste of resources.

Moreover, the Jade Marrow Golden Ganoderma could be used to refine the Golden Liquid Jade Return Pill, a medicinal pill that aided Foundation Establishment cultivators in achieving Golden Core Formation.

If the Immortal Sect had abundant resources, cultivating successive batches of Jade Marrow Golden Ganoderma in their Herb Garden for harvesting would allow them to refine both Golden Liquid Jade Return Pills and a small quantity of Foundation Establishment Pills simultaneously.

However, the Immortal Sect's resources were limited. While they possessed a comprehensive variety of spiritual herbs, Jade Marrow Golden Ganoderma could only be cultivated in two Grotto-Heavens. Even these limited yields barely sufficed for refining Golden Liquid Jade Return Pills, let alone wasting any on Foundation Establishment Pills.
Though lower-tier cultivators vehemently opposed this policy, the fundamental difference between immortal cultivation and mechanical civilization lay in the absolute authority of the upper echelons.

A Golden Core Venerable's value far exceeded that of ten Foundation Establishment cultivators. Given a single Jade Marrow Golden Ganoderma, would it be used to refine a Golden Liquid Jade Return Pill or a Foundation Establishment Pill?
The answer was self-evident.
It was precisely for this reason that, for Immortal Sect cultivators, the challenge of reaching Foundation Establishment felt as insurmountable as ascending to the heavens.
In ancient times, cultivators at least had the Foundation Establishment Pill to look forward to. Now, however, 99% of them had to rely solely on their own efforts to break through.
It was precisely for this reason that cultivators from the Immortal Sect yearned to enter the Great Dao Academy.

While the Great Dao Academy didn't produce Foundation Establishment Pills, it did refine spirit medicines one tier below, which assist in Foundation Establishment. They also possessed numerous secret techniques to increase the success rate of Foundation Establishment. Moreover, their vast collection of Foundation Establishment experiences—tens of thousands in number—ensured that every cultivator could find a method tailored to their individual circumstances.
The Purple Fire Pill Chen Mobai used to break through to the Fifth-Stage of Qi Refinement was produced by the local Chi Xia Academy in Danxia City. Only a hundred pills were released each month.

Chen Mobai secured the purchasing qualification by forging a connection with a senior student at Chi Xia Academy while selling Talisman Paper. The senior, who happened to be working part-time as a customer service representative for the academy's online flagship store, pulled some strings internally.
Every type of Medicinal Pill required detailed usage instructions and a guarantee of trustworthiness.
In the Immortal Sect's ancient past, many cultivators had suffered fates worse than death due to indiscriminately consuming pills.
Nowadays, unless a pill comes from a reputable pharmacy—complete with instructions, the refiner's signature, and a certificate of quality—no cultivator would dare ingest it.
